note: Generation caps per case, and per model overrides under models[<--model-id>][<case_id>]. hf runs fall back to the case defaults below; api runs have no fallback and refuse a (model, case) with no entry. All three models' caps were calibrated on 2026-10-27: each is the smallest step at least twice the longest finished reply, with cut-off prompts re-sent at 32768. The th_knowledge caps are placeholders copied from th_text, not calibrated; a reply cut off by its cap scores as wrong. protocols[<--model-id>] is the sampling an api run uses when no sampling flag is given (vendor thinking-mode settings; top_k is sent in extra_body); an api run for a model with no entry is refused, and hf runs are greedy.
